P_0x002BCE: A Schutedenia soldier. Serves as Rodney's aide. Sharp-minded, but lacks flexibility.
P_0x002C58: A soldier of the Kirkus army. A magic officer skilled in sorcery. Fastidious and obsessed with justice.
P_0x002CE3: A demon priest serving the god of destruction, Sarva Volkruss. Polite in speech but cold and merciless. Works with Shu to prepare for Volkruss's revival.
P_0x002DAF: Captain of the ATX Team's Steel Dragon Squadron. Quiet and seemingly calm, but only because he hides his feelings - in truth a hot-blooded man who burns quietly inside. Loves gambling, and gets more excited the worse the odds are. He and Excellen are lovers, and though he rarely shows it, he privately treasures her above all else. Rank: Lieutenant.
P_0x002F68: A pilot of the ATX Team's Steel Dragon Squadron. Calm and intelligent at heart, but so self-promoting and prone to going with the flow that others rarely see that side of her. She resents how coldly Kyosuke always treats her, but she loves him more than anyone. An excellent pilot, especially skilled at high-mobility and gunnery combat. A heavy drinker who loves watching others get drunk. Rank: Ensign.
P_0x0031A7: A pilot of the ATX Team's Steel Dragon Squadron, nicknamed Billy. A serious young man with a strong sense of duty and honor. Has a strong sense of justice and hates anything underhanded. Often gets dragged along by the reckless Kyosuke and Excellen. Possesses the special psychic ability of "telekinesis" and pilots a unit equipped with the T-LINK System. Rank: Ensign.
